summary: Master financial services contract law and compliance. Learn ISDA, GMRA, and regulatory alignment with AI-driven tools. Enroll for expert-led training.
lede: Financial services contract law training is for legal, compliance and risk professionals handling complex transaction documents and obligations. It covers negotiating derivatives documentation, assessing netting and collateral provisions, resolving cross-border jurisdiction questions, and managing lending, consumer finance and digital contract risks through practical review, drafting and audit exercises.
audienceIntro: This program is curated for mid-to-senior level professionals who manage the legal and regulatory risks inherent in complex financial transactions.
audience: Asset Management Compliance Specialists focused on GMSLA
modules: International Regulatory Architecture and Contractual Impact
Mastering the ISDA Framework and Derivatives Documentation
Securities Financing and Repo Market Agreements
Cross-Border Jurisdictional Challenges and Conflict of Laws
Lending, Covenants, and Credit Facility Compliance
Consumer Finance and Retail Banking Compliance Law
Digital Transformation and AI in Contract Management
Default, Enforcement, and Dispute Resolution Strategies
ESG Integration and Sustainable Finance Documentation
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in legal, compliance, or risk management within the financial services sector. A foundational understanding of financial instruments and basic contract law principles is required. Familiarity with ISDA or Basel frameworks is highly recommended for maximum benefit.
